_comment: STRUCTURE layer. The spine: goal, laps, unit order, prerequisites, content pointers. Stable. Content authors do NOT edit this file.
title: Learn to Program (Beginner)
goal: Recognize and follow good problem-solving through many guided problems — not an unaided final exam. Breadth of guided problems is the product.
ceiling: Builds 'recognize + follow' via tap/choose/order exercises; not 'write from a blank editor'. Graduates' next step is writing real code in a real editor.
process: UEPCC: Understand -> Examples -> Plan -> Code -> Check
